full_name: Yun Ni | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2017–2018 Radcliffe Institute Graduate Student Fellow Harvard University
bio: Yun Ni is a PhD candidate in comparative literature at Harvard University with research interests in classical philology, medieval English, French, German, and Latin literary and religious writings from the 12th to the 16th centuries.
